lines.text: In 1932, Australia sent its army to war against twenty thousand emus.
lines.say: In nineteen thirty-two, Australia sent its army to war, against twenty thousand emus.

lines.text: Twenty thousand hungry emus had marched onto the wheat farms of Western Australia, eating everything in sight.
So the army sent one major, two soldiers, two machine guns and ten thousand bullets.
lines.say: So the army sent one major, two soldiers, two machine guns, and ten thousand bullets.

lines.text: But when the guns opened fire, the emus split into small groups and ran in every direction.
So the major set an ambush at a dam.
A thousand emus walked straight towards the gun,
Next, he put a gun on a truck.
But the truck couldn't catch the birds, and the ride was so bumpy the gunner never fired a shot.
After six days and two and a half thousand bullets, the army went home.
They came back for a second try.
Final score, by the major's count: 986 emus, for nearly ten thousand bullets.
lines.say: Final score, by the major's count: nine hundred and eighty-six emus, for nearly ten thousand bullets.
